INSERT INTO raid_hourly_stats (guild_id, hour_key, join_count)
        SELECT * FROM UNNEST(
            $1::bigint[],
            $2::text[],
            $3::bigint[]
        )
        ON CONFLICT (guild_id, hour_key) DO UPDATE SET
            join_count = raid_hourly_stats.join_count + EXCLUDED.join_count
